summary: All 28 requirements from spec/spec.md are satisfied. One minor note: float coercion is listed in the spec but not implemented — no current key uses float type, so it does not affect correctness.

schema_completeness.detail: All 10 keys present with correct type, default, env_var, and validation rules matching spec Table lines 11-22.

type_coercion.detail: int, bool, enum, and string coercion correctly implemented per spec lines 38-45.
notes: int: parses via int(), guards against bool subclass, raises ConfigValidationError on failure
bool: accepts true/false (case-insensitive), 1/0, yes/no, on/off as string; rejects others
enum: coerces to str then validates against allowed list (case-sensitive)
string: coerces non-strings via str(), validates non_empty where applicable

priority_cascade.detail: Four-layer priority cascade correctly implemented: CLI (highest) > env vars > config file > defaults (lowest). Matches spec lines 49-56.
priority_cascade.implementation_trace: defaults loaded first, then config_file overrides (unknown keys ignored, None skipped), then env_vars overrides (by env_var name mapping), then cli_args overrides. Empty string '' from lower source is correctly overridden by non-None higher source value.
